scenarios.name: Inspect actions for a recent document card

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are displayed in Grid View
the user hovers over a recent part card
the user opens its actions menu
the menu offers Open and opens with options
the menu offers Remove from Recent
the menu offers commands to open or explore the containing folder
the user clicks outside the menu
